info.name: Paxos Account Members API Credentials API

params.name: order
params.description: Determines whether the items are returned in ascending (ASC), or descending (DESC) order. Defaults to DESC.

params.name: order_by
params.description: The specific field by which the returned results will be ordered. Defaults to CREATED_AT.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0 (return all records). Max value is 1000.

params.name: page_cursor
params.description: The page cursor for pagination. Use the next_page_cursor from the response to get the next page.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Filter for credentials with a set of statuses. Defaults to [APPROVED].

params.name: ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the UUIDs of the credentials. Limit 100.

params.name: client_ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the client IDs of the credentials. Limit 100.

items.docs: List all API credentials that have been created.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The client_id of the credentials to delete.

items.docs: Delete the given API Credentials, preventing them from being used for authentication.
